title: Solar Noon Calculator: When the Sun Peaks
description: Find true solar noon for any place and date with the Solar Noon Calculator — equation of time and time-zone offset explained. Free.
summary_sentence: For example, solar noon in New York on June 21 falls at about 12:57 p.m. EDT — nearly an hour after clock noon, because the city sits 14 degrees west of its daylight time meridian.
quick_answer: The Solar Noon Calculator finds the clock time when the Sun crosses your meridian — its highest point of the day. Enter place and date and read solar noon — rarely 12:00, since longitude and the equation of time shift it.

Computed solar noon: June 21 ≈ 12:57 EDT; December 21 ≈ 11:53 EST. Longitude inside the zone sets the base (~56 minutes past the hour on daylight time), the equation of time wobbles it ±15 minutes through the year.
London sits almost on its time meridian, so solar noon hugs 12:00 GMT (13:01 BST in June) — the exception that proves how unusual an on-meridian city is.

faq: The instant the Sun crosses your local meridian — due south (northern mid-latitudes) or due north (southern) — reaching its highest altitude of the day.
Clocks run on zone meridians and mean time; the Sun runs on your longitude and apparent time. The gap is longitude offset plus the equation of time, sometimes shifted an hour by daylight saving.
What is the equation of time?
The difference between apparent solar time (sundials) and mean time (clocks), swinging about −14 to +16 minutes across the year — it is why sundials need a correction table.
Is the Sun due south at solar noon?
In northern mid-latitudes yes — a free compass check. In the tropics it can pass north or overhead depending on the date.
How accurate is the computed time?
Within about a minute for most places and dates with the standard algorithm — ample for shadows, panels and sundials.
Does solar noon split daylight in half?
Yes by construction: sunrise-to-noon and noon-to-sunset are equal spans of solar time (clock spans match closely too).
Can solar noon be before 11:30 or after 12:30 clock time?
Easily — far inside wide zones (or with daylight saving) it strays over an hour from 12:00. Western China's single zone pushes it past 15:00 in places.
